official_sources.fact: INSPIRE Index Polygons are monthly, indicative polygons; July 2026 release was published 5 July 2026 and represents the previous month.
Native polygon coordinates are British National Grid; reprojection to WGS84 can shift features by up to 15m.
LIDAR Composite DTM 1m is EPSG:27700, metres ODN, surveys 2000-2022, +/-15cm RMSE.
Terrain50 grid is 10km tiles, 200x200 cells, 50m pixels; heights are pixel-centre values to nearest 0.1m; GML/PRJ/metadata accompany ASC.

controls.evidence: hmlr recovery joins authority_dir / zip_name without first requiring a basename-only safe filename.
controls.requirement: Reject absolute paths, separators, dot-dot and non-basename seed ZIP names before download.

controls.evidence: safe extraction flattens archive members to source_name.name and can overwrite equal basenames from different directories.
controls.requirement: Pre-scan selected GML/XML members and block duplicate destination basenames.

controls.evidence: HMLR extraction has a total limit but no explicit per-member bound.
controls.requirement: Apply bounded per-member GML/XML size before extraction and include size receipt.

controls.evidence: recovery accepts any GML/XML vector set and matcher scans every Fiona-readable layer.
controls.requirement: Bind each authority download to the canonical cadastral GML member set and fail on ambiguous multiple candidate GML datasets.

controls.evidence: matcher uses a broad regex matching inspire/cadastral/identifier/generic id properties.
controls.requirement: Promotable exact ID must originate from an HMLR INSPIRE identifier field/layer contract, not an unrelated generic ID property.

controls.evidence: matcher source files have SHA256 but selected match is not directly chained to its downloaded authority ZIP SHA in the match record.
controls.requirement: Persist archive SHA -> member SHA -> layer -> feature ID lineage for each promoted polygon.

controls.evidence: sampler accepts an arbitrary --wcs-url override.
controls.requirement: Business mode must use the official Environment Agency HTTPS WCS authority/path or a canonically pinned equivalent.

controls.evidence: capabilities/describe/getcoverage follow redirects without final-host policy.
controls.requirement: Capture redirect chain and fail if final WCS authority leaves the approved Environment Agency service provenance.

controls.evidence: EA polygon loader checks length=3 but not explicit unique target row set before sampling.
controls.requirement: Require exactly rows 30762,46142,61522 once each, with distinct parcel/HMLR identities, before any WCS request.

controls.evidence: EA sampler serializes min/max rounded to 3 decimals and discards raw extrema.
controls.requirement: Persist raw extrema used for metric computation; round only presentation fields.

controls.evidence: metric guard rounds difference and delta to 3 decimals before applying 0.001m tolerance.
controls.requirement: Apply tolerance to unrounded finite raw difference/delta, then serialize rounded values afterward.

controls.evidence: metric guard accepts any finite nonnegative CLI tolerance although task contract pins 0.001m.
controls.requirement: Attempt-020 business mode must reject tolerance values other than exactly 0.001m.

controls.evidence: preserved confidence is converted to float but not required finite or 0..100 in metric guard.
controls.requirement: Require finite preserved confidence within [0,100] and >=96 before propagation.

controls.evidence: metric guard joins row/HMLR but does not compare parcel_id against a preserved/canonical expected binding.
controls.requirement: Bind each target row to parcel_30762/parcel_46142/parcel_61522 throughout metric output.

controls.evidence: metric guard copies geotiff_sha256 with .get() and can pass with it missing.
controls.requirement: Require a 64-hex GeoTIFF SHA256 per row before metric-ready status.

controls.evidence: after an empty exact-format query resolver falls back to area-only and accepts loose ascii/grid/zip label matches.
controls.requirement: Fallback candidate must still prove OS Terrain50 ASCII Grid and GML (Grid) format identity before download.

controls.evidence: resolver exposes --api-base and does not restrict it to official OS Downloads authority in business mode.
controls.requirement: Pin business resolution to official HTTPS OS Downloads API provenance.

controls.evidence: selected download URLs/redirects are not constrained by scheme/final source provenance.
controls.requirement: Require HTTPS and capture official API selection plus approved final-download provenance in receipt.

controls.evidence: wrapper accepts arbitrary local configured archive/root and can promote its crosscheck without an OS resolver receipt.
controls.requirement: Configured inputs need a matching official OS product/version/download SHA receipt or remain non-promotable test inputs.

controls.evidence: crosschecker joins EA by row and uses HMLR identity but does not locally compare EA parcel_id/HMLR ID before sampling.
controls.requirement: Require row, parcel_id and HMLR INSPIRE ID equality between HMLR and EA inputs before Terrain50 sampling.

controls.evidence: EA rows are indexed with dict comprehension, allowing duplicate row numbers to overwrite silently.
controls.requirement: Reject duplicate EA rows explicitly before constructing the join map.

controls.evidence: crosschecker gives every all-touched 50m cell equal weight even for tiny polygon overlaps; OS defines values at pixel centres.
controls.requirement: Define and receipt a deterministic pixel-centre/overlap-area policy; do not let tiny boundary touches silently equal-weight the parcel crosscheck.

controls.evidence: directory mode sets source_archive_sha256=null and lacks one root-level snapshot binding.
controls.requirement: Hash and receipt the exact selected tile-file set before sampling so configured-root bytes cannot change mid-run.

controls.evidence: web verifier reads operations manifest once and does not re-read it after probing all member files.
controls.requirement: Hash manifest at probe start and end; require identical bytes for a single acceptance snapshot.

controls.evidence: operation/source/example files are fetched independently without a common run/snapshot epoch field.
controls.requirement: All served member files must bind to the same manifest/run epoch and task/attempt/continuation identity.

controls.evidence: final measured rows propagate parcel_id from EA and numeric values, but do not fully carry upstream HMLR archive/member, EA GeoTIFF and Terrain50 archive/tile hashes.
controls.requirement: Candidate rows must carry immutable per-row parcel identity plus complete upstream source-hash lineage before web acceptance.
